memories.content: The user keeps two potted herbs beside a south-facing window.
During a week when the user watered every day based only on the soil surface, the leaves of one plant turned yellow.
During a week when the user checked below the soil surface with a finger before watering, the plant grew new leaves.
On a day the user left the window open for a long time, strong wind knocked over one pot.
The next day, the user moved the pot inward from the windowsill so the same wind would not knock it over.
The user put a plant-name label in a small pot received from their maternal aunt.
The user confused the care instructions for an unlabeled pot with those for another plant.
The user's maternal aunt considers understanding the sunlight at a pot's location more important than watering frequency when caring for it.
Before creating a plant-care reminder, check each plant's name and most recent watering date.
The soil in the user's potted herbs beside the south-facing window dries at different rates depending on the season and amount of sunlight.
The user keeps four folding chairs for family barbecues in storage.
When six family members gathered in a noisy indoor restaurant, the user asked several times for the person across from them to repeat what was said.
The user held the next gathering in their father's yard and moved between seats while speaking with everyone.
On a day the user started the barbecue at midday, sunlight led them to finish the meal quickly.
The next time, the user started at 6 p.m. and remained outside until sunset.
Because the side dishes brought by the user's mother and older sister had no labels, the user opened the same container twice.
At the next gathering, the user wrote each food's name and who brought it on a small piece of paper.
After a barbecue, the user's younger brother prefers to divide leftover food into small containers to take home rather than discard it.
The local agent can summarize preparation and responses from prior family barbecues but cannot know the next attendees or weather.
The user's father's yard receives strong direct sunlight at midday; after 6 p.m., shade and wind lower the felt temperature.

analysis.overview: The frames concern separate practical domains: reference records plant-care observations and safeguards, while compared records family-barbecue preparation, comfort, communication, labeling, leftovers, and planning limits. Their recurring themes do not establish shared operational policies or scope-aligned disagreements.
